simple.summary: מְצֻלָּה (mᵉtsullâh) means shade First listed occurrence: Zech 1 8.

definitions.full: H4699. metsullah מְצֻלָה noun feminine dubious word: Zech 1:8 the myrtles which are ׳בַּמּ , apparently some locality about Jerusalem, called the basin, hollow ; GASm glen or valley-bottom ; possibly is מְצֻלָּה , < מְצִלָּה , shadow (III. צלל ).
